column4: A structured "1-3-1" response format that frames a decision as one problem statement, three labeled options with trade-offs, and one clear recommendation with a concrete plan.
column14: DEFAULT - lightweight, zero-dependency communication pattern useful on any agent platform for presenting trade-off decisions
column15: Use when a user explicitly requests a "1-3-1", asks for options/choices on a technical decision, or needs a proposal to forward to stakeholders; Do not use for questions with one obvious answer or when the user has already committed to an approach; State the problem in exactly one sentence focused on the desired outcome, not implementation details; Present exactly three genuinely distinct options labeled A/B/C, each with a short description plus pros and cons; Make a direct, justified recommendation for one option, then give concrete success criteria and an actionable step-by-step implementation plan for it; Verify the response has exactly one problem sentence, exactly three options with trade-offs, and one clear recommendation whose success criteria and plan match
